card.name: Market wording: placing on the market, postmarket
card.fires_on: Words in the phrase 'place ... on the market' in EU timber regulation citations, and 'market' after 'post' in postmarketing reports.

modes.label: Placing on the market
modes.description: Words in 'operators who place timber on the market' in a regulation citation.
modes.example: laying down the obligations of operators who<< place>> timber and timber products on the market.

modes.label: Postmarketing use
modes.description: The word 'market' right after 'post' when side effects are reported from use after approval.
modes.example: have been reported with post<<market>> use of SILIQ.
